origin: it should NOT report violation for a valid pipe
source:
defmodule Test do
  def some_function(arg) do
    arg |> foo() |> bar()
  end

  def other_function(arg) do
    arg
    |> foo()
    |> bar()
  end
end

origin: it should NOT report violation for a valid pipe with a block
source:
defmodule Test do
  def other_function(arg) do
    arg
    |> foo()
    |> case do
      :x -> :y
      :u -> :u
    end
    |> bar()
  end
end
